$reason: The strip with a fallback list: `role="bogus<TAB>tablist<LF>list"`, a tab and a line break between the tokens. The three engines take the first token that names a role, on any ASCII whitespace, so it is a `tablist`; axe's own reader takes the value whole unless asked for its fallback, and even then splits on a space alone, and reads no role at all. The gate takes the engines' side, because the question is what the reader announces; a reading that collapsed the tab and not the line break would find no role, and one that collapsed the line break and not the tab would find a `list`.
